name: InvokeWebService
label: Invoke Web Service
description: Invokes a web service (REST or SOAP) and returns the response text.

fields.name: EndpointUrl
fields.label: Endpoint URL
fields.description: The URL of the web service endpoint (e.g., https://api.example.com/data).

fields.name: HttpMethod
fields.label: HTTP Method
fields.description: The HTTP method to use: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc.

selectOptions.label: GET
selectOptions.description: Retrieves data from the specified resource.

selectOptions.label: POST
selectOptions.description: Submits data to be processed to the specified resource.

selectOptions.label: PUT
selectOptions.description: Updates a current resource with new data.

selectOptions.label: PATCH
selectOptions.description: Applies partial modifications to a resource.

fields.name: RequestBody
fields.label: Request Body
fields.description: The request body to send in POST, PUT, etc. Leave empty for GET requests.

fields.name: ContentType
fields.label: Content Type
fields.description: Specifies the content type for the request body (e.g., application/json, text/xml).

fields.name: AcceptHeader
fields.label: Accept Header
fields.description: Specifies the content type expected in the response (e.g., application/json, text/xml).

fields.name: AuthenticationType
fields.label: Authentication Type
fields.description: Type of authentication to use: None, Basic, Bearer, etc.

selectOptions.label: Basic
selectOptions.description: Uses Basic authentication with username and password.

selectOptions.label: Bearer
selectOptions.description: Uses Bearer token authentication for OAuth 2.0.

fields.name: TimeoutSeconds
fields.label: Timeout Seconds
fields.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the service to respond.

fields.name: UseDefaultCredentials
fields.label: Use Default Credentials
fields.description: If true, sends credentials of the current user with the request.

fields.name: IgnoreSslErrors
fields.label: Ignore SSL Errors
fields.description: If true, ignores SSL certificate validation errors.

fields.name: Headers
fields.label: Headers
fields.description: Custom HTTP headers to include in the request.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the raw response from the web service as a string.

fields.name: ResponseCode
fields.label: Response Code
fields.description: Returns the HTTP status code from the web service.

fields.name: ResponseHeaders
fields.label: Response Headers
fields.description: Returns the response headers from the web service.
